title: 第3702章 每个人都是变数第3701章 或许有人想做黄雀
lines: 李总旗在大殿房顶上陪着君无邪站了很久。
屋顶上的积雪已经没过了靴面，脚底传来的凉意隔着厚厚的鞋底都透了上来，在足心处聚成一团阴冷。
下方大殿里偶尔传出几声武夫压低的交谈，细碎的话语被风搅碎，混在落雪声里，听不真切。
直到他感到实在太冷了，才回到大殿内。
其实，这样的天气，这样的温度，对于觉醒者而言，根本不存在寒冷。
何况他还是三境觉醒者，体内血气充盈，正阳之火旺盛。
可在这古坟镇的雪夜里，有一种冷，仿佛可以穿透血气之火，钻入骨髓里。
那冷意不来自外界，更像是从脚底下的土地深处漫上来的，沿着脚踝、小腿、膝盖，一寸一寸往上爬，像无数根细长的冰针，密密地扎进骨头缝里。
他回到大殿内的时候，已接近凌晨了。
大殿里的油灯已经燃去了大半，火苗跳得越来越弱，将满殿的影子拉得又长又斜。
那些武夫们都还很精神，没有一个闭眼休息。
尽管知道那位仙师就在房顶上，可他们的心里还是有恐惧，不敢闭眼睡觉。
有人抱膝坐着，下巴抵着膝盖，目光直勾勾地盯着地面。
有人在墙角缩成一团，裹紧了身上的衣袍，眼皮虽然沉重地垂着，却时不时猛地弹开，像被什么东西从浅眠中骤然惊醒。
直到李总旗进来坐下，这些武夫的心神才松懈了下来，其中有几人抵不住困意，浅浅地进入了睡眠。
这些天，他们连日赶路，休息的时间极少。
每日基本上只休息一两个时辰。
加上今晚上半夜经历那样的事情，精神消耗严重，实在是扛不住了。
他们的呼吸渐渐变得绵长而均匀，垂下的脑袋微微地点着，偶尔有人发出一两声含糊的呓语，翻个身又沉了下去。
闭上眼睛假寐的李总旗，却是怎么都睡不着。
他完全没有半点睡意。
大殿里很安静，只有灯火偶尔爆出一声细小的噼啪，以及门外风雪擦过窗纸的沙沙轻响。
他的脑海中不断回荡着君无邪之前说的那些话。
这个时代的乱世，那些妖邪诡异的目的是要彻底颠覆人间！
这句话对他的内心冲击实在太大了。
难以想象，将来的乱世，世间会变成何等模样。
或许，有元初这些外界来的绝世天骄，未来没有那么的可怕。
好在有他们这些外界来客啊。
否则，仅凭此界的觉醒者，就算最终在与妖邪诡异的对抗中取得胜利。
只怕，整个人间也千疮百孔了，不知道要付出怎样可怕的代价。
没有人皇在世的乱世，或者说在新的人皇出现之前的乱世岁月，对于世人而言无异于噩梦，甚至是人间炼狱。
为何就没有一劳永逸的法子。
乱世总是不能彻底终结？
史上就有数次大乱世，根据史书记载，那样的时代极其的黑暗与残酷。
每次乱世来临，对文明都会造成巨大的灾难。
自太祖建国以来，数千年时光，王朝上至皇帝与大臣，下至普通百姓。
多少代人的努力，才有了璀璨的文明，安平的盛世。
可这样的盛世，即将被打破了，将要消失了。
李总旗的心中对未来有着深深的忧虑，也有恐惧。
太平盛世，自己每天从镇魔司回家，还能陪陪妻子与儿女，享受幸福温馨的生活。
可没有了太平盛世，还会有那样幸福温馨的生活吗？

Mr. Li Qi stood with Jun Wuxie on the roof of the hall for a long time.
The snow on the roof had already covered the uppers of the boots, and the coolness coming from the soles of the feet penetrated through the thick soles, gathering into a cold ball at the soles of the feet.
Occasionally, a few low-pitched conversations of warriors could be heard in the hall below. The fine words were shattered by the wind and mixed with the sound of falling snow, making it difficult to hear them clearly.
It wasn't until he felt it was too cold that he returned to the hall.
In fact, with this kind of weather and this kind of temperature, for the awakened, there is no cold at all.
What's more, he is still an awakened person in the three realms, with full blood and strong Yang fire in his body.
But in this snowy night in Tufun Town, there is a kind of coldness that seems to penetrate the fire of blood and penetrate into the bone marrow.
The coldness did not come from the outside world, but more like it came from the depths of the earth beneath the feet, crawling up inch by inch along the ankles, calves, and knees, like countless slender ice needles, densely piercing into the seams of the bones.
It was almost early morning when he returned to the hall.
Most of the oil lamps in the main hall have burned out, and the flames are getting weaker and weaker, making the shadows all over the hall long and slanted.
The warriors were all still very energetic, and no one closed their eyes to rest.
Although they knew that the immortal master was on the roof, they still had fear in their hearts and did not dare to close their eyes and sleep.
Someone was sitting with his knees in his arms, his chin resting on his knees, and his eyes fixed on the ground.
Someone huddled up in the corner, tightly wrapped in their robes. Although their eyelids drooped heavily, they would snap open from time to time, as if something suddenly woke them up from a light sleep.
It wasn't until General Li came in and sat down that the warriors relaxed. Some of them couldn't resist their sleepiness and fell asleep lightly.
These days, they are on the road for days with very little time to rest.
Basically, I only have one or two hours of rest every day.
In addition, after experiencing something like that in the first half of the night tonight, my mental energy was severely exhausted, and I really couldn't bear it anymore.
Their breathing gradually became long and even, and their lowered heads nodded slightly. Occasionally, someone uttered one or two vague murmurs, turned over and sank again.
Mr. Li Qi closed his eyes and pretended to sleep, but he couldn't fall asleep no matter what.
He was not sleepy at all.
The hall was very quiet, with only the occasional small crackle of the lights and the soft rustle of the wind and snow scraping against the window paper outside the door.
The words Jun Wuxie said before kept echoing in his mind.
In the troubled times of this era, the purpose of those evil spirits is to completely subvert the world!
This sentence had a huge impact on his heart.
It’s hard to imagine what the world will look like in the troubled times of the future.
Perhaps, with the peerless geniuses from the outside world like Yuan Chu, the future would not be so scary.
Fortunately, there are outside visitors like them.
Otherwise, just the awakened people in this world can finally win the battle against the evil spirits.
I'm afraid that the entire human world is also riddled with holes, and I don't know what terrible price we have to pay.
The troubled times without the Human Emperor, or the troubled years before the new Emperor appeared, were nothing more than nightmares or even purgatory on earth for the world.
Why is there no permanent solution?
The troubled times never end completely?
There have been several great turmoils in history. According to historical records, such times were extremely dark and cruel.
Every time trouble comes, it will cause huge disasters to civilization.
Since the founding of the country by Taizu, for thousands of years, the dynasty has extended from the emperor and ministers to ordinary people.
It took many generations of hard work to achieve a splendid civilization and an peaceful and prosperous age.
But this prosperous age is about to be broken and disappear.
General Li Qi has deep worries and fears about the future in his heart.
In the peaceful and prosperous times, he would go home from the Demon Suppression Division every day, and he could still spend time with his wife and children, enjoying a happy and warm life.
But without peace and prosperity, would there still be such a happy and warm life?
